dog.description_text:
Since I'm a long stay pup, my adoption fee has been reduced! Visit me today to find out my favorite treats and how you can take me home!

What my friends at ACC say about me:

I can go home today!

I would do best in a home with only adult humans.

I prefer to call the shots and enjoy coming to you when I'm ready for pets.

My foster writes: Crown is a handsome, energetic dog looking for an active home to match his adventurous spirit! He loves walks, attention, and all the pets he can get. Despite his playful energy, he's very respectful in the home and has great house manners. Crown already knows cues like "sit" and "look at me," and he's eager to learn more every day. He enjoys being outside, exploring, and taking in the world around him. Crown is incredibly affectionate, friendly with the people he meets, and happiest when he's close to his person. With his sweet personality, smart mind, and loving nature, this really good boy is going to make an amazing companion.

Crown is a cute energetic loving dog. He loves to play fetch and getting pet, if you work from home, he will not leave your side. His favorite thing is going out for walks and exploring the neighborhood. Crown would love to get adopted by someone who can take him to the park and get lots of exercise
dog.name: Crown
